name: Building
description: Urban and rural buildings with an immediate point of interest

fields.description: a hot stone workshop taking commissions while quietly repairing forbidden weapons.
tiled pools, rented lockers, gossiping attendants, and discreet meeting rooms.
a guarded, professionally run house offering companionship, information, and strict privacy.
a public sanctuary dedicated to {{ religion.name }}, with an altar, charitable kitchen, archives, and restricted crypt.
fragrant shelves holding a remedy claimed to treat {{ affliction.name }}, plus poisons, preserved creatures, and mislabeled experiments.
offices, training spaces, a contract board, and a members-only meeting chamber.
stacked cargo, overhead walkways, night watchmen, and one shipment missing from the ledger.
ornate public seating, cramped backstage passages, workshops, and hidden royal boxes.
a single crowded classroom whose teacher knows every family secret in the district.
a water- or wind-powered workplace surrounded by dust, noise, laborers, and moving machinery.
public hearing chamber, evidence rooms, legal archives, and judges' private offices.
an eccentric vertical residence whose rooms do not follow exterior dimensions.
a fortified noble residence operating under foreign laws and constant surveillance.
a domed hilltop laboratory tracking stars, weather, and something approaching from above.
a decaying estate left furnished after its occupants vanished during dinner.
a concealed arena with betting rooms, healers, cages, and bribed officials.
A poorly guarded local collection contains an object whose official origin is false.
The most-read books all lack the same page, while a sealed shelf still seems visited.
A cluttered shop whose owner knows visitors’ needs before they voice them.
A tense garrison hides the repeated disappearance of its sentries.
A secure workshop sells and repairs weapons of the following kind: {{ weapons.name }}; it also conceals the origin of a prestigious order.
Municipal records contradict residents’ memories of an entire district.
A noisy establishment trading rumors, contracts, and messages for absent clients.
A celebrated kitchen depends on a rare ingredient whose supply has stopped.
Simple rooms surround a common hall where travelers and residents exchange news and suspicions.
An attached home hides rooms whose windows do not match its facade.
Crops flourish in sterile soil, and the family refuses every inspection.
At night, statues, kiosks, and paths form a different plan from the one seen by day.
Rare plants thrive around a greenhouse that officially has no keyholder.
Guarded and sealed vaults also hold deposits their owners want forgotten.
Offerings thrown into the water reappear in strangers’ pockets.
Markets, proclamations, and protests compete beneath a controversial monument.
An active congregation devoted to {{ religion.name }} maintains a place of worship whose crypt predates the city.
A vast spiritual and political institution dedicated to {{ religion.name }} keeps jealously guarded relics.
The city’s main entrance is crowded with guards and tax collectors, stranded travelers, and suspicious goods.
The communal oven has burned without fuel for several nights and draws visitors after closing.
The shop receives unusual meat from a supplier absent from every record.
A cramped workshop makes a remarkable object at the cost of time or a rare material.
Mounts, grooms, and travelers surround an animal no one can approach.
A prestigious residence gathers servants, guests, and heirs around a family secret.
The administration insists a cell occupied for years has never existed.
Ordinary objects mingle with stolen keepsakes and relics; the seller does not know the true purpose of this curio: {{ curio.name }}.
Many households share stairs, a courtyard, and disputes around a bricked-up apartment.
Salvagers search heaps of waste around an object slowly transforming nearby materials.
Machine and vehicle wrecks supply parts to an intensely protective mechanic.
